title: Starter mounts
text: Starter mounts or so called "race mounts" are the mounts that each race gets on the start of the game. All starter mounts can be bought with any character. Starter mounts need to be bought from the place each race starts their journey. All these mounts need to be raised to adults before they can be used. Lilyut Horse (Nuian) Brown Horse Lilyut Horse can be obtained from an NPC in Solzreed Peninsula, Wardton with gold. There are 3 different color variations. Mount Basic Gray Lilyut Horse This horse is from the Lilyut Hills, a region known for its fine horses. The Gray Lilyut Horse has the following skills: Lv5: Run!Run!Mana 20Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Pet Move Speed +50% for 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv10: Mounted AttackMounted AttackInstant2sec CooldownDeals 350% of Melee Attack as Physical Damage with a chance of Tripping targets while mounted. Enables rider to attack an enemy behind them when in Bloodlust mode. Lv15: Back KickBack KickInstant18sec CooldownStrengthens the mount's rearward kick, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and Tripping the enemy. Lv20: Mounted DefenseMounted DefenseInstant1min CooldownGrants mount and rider immunity to Ranged Damage, Knockback, and Stun for 5sec. Lv25: BreakthroughBreakthroughInstant30sec CooldownCharges forward for 3sec, breaking through enemy lines. Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies. This skill counts as a Push effect. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount. Base Move Speed 9m/s Mount Basic Brown Lilyut Horse This horse is from the Lilyut Hills, a region known for its fine horses.
